# Sweet Clover Bakery

> Sweet Clover Bakery is a bakery and custom dessert shop website concept associated with Maryville, Missouri. This website presents five main categories of bakery offerings: breakfast pastries, freshly baked breads, cookies and treats, seasonal specials, and custom cakes and desserts. The website was developed as a Web Development II student project at Northwest Missouri State University.

## About Sweet Clover Bakery
Sweet Clover Bakery introduces a bakery concept focused on baked goods for everyday enjoyment and special occasions.

The website covers:
- Breakfast pastries, including croissants, cinnamon rolls, muffins, and seasonal scones.
- Breads, including sourdough, honey wheat, rosemary garlic focaccia, and cinnamon raisin bread.
- Cookies and treats, including chocolate chip cookies, sugar cookies, brownies, and oatmeal cream pies.
- Seasonal specials, including seasonal scones, cupcakes, cookies, and specialty cakes.
- Custom desserts, including birthday cakes, wedding desserts, decorated cookies, cupcakes, and dessert boxes.

- [Menu](https://334fa26.github.io/web-dev-ii-fa26-group-project-group-4/menu.html): Bakery product and menu information.
- [About](https://334fa26.github.io/web-dev-ii-fa26-group-project-group-4/about.html): Background information about Sweet Clover Bakery.
- [FAQ](https://334fa26.github.io/web-dev-ii-fa26-group-project-group-4/faq.html): Answers about ordering, delivery, custom desserts, advance notice, and allergens.
- [Contact](https://334fa26.github.io/web-dev-ii-fa26-group-project-group-4/contact.html): Contact and custom-order request information.
## Bakery Product Categories

### Breakfast and Pastries

Croissants, cinnamon rolls, muffins, and seasonal scones.

### Freshly Baked Breads

Sourdough, honey wheat, rosemary garlic focaccia, and cinnamon raisin bread.

### Cookies and Treats
Chocolate chip cookies, sugar cookies, brownies, and oatmeal cream pies.

### Seasonal Specials

Rotating seasonal scones, cupcakes, cookies, and specialty cakes.

### Custom Cakes and Desserts

Birthday cakes, wedding desserts, decorated cookies, cupcakes, and dessert boxes.

## Ordering Information
- Custom orders include cakes, cookies, cupcakes, and dessert boxes.
- The recommended advance notice for custom orders is at least seven days.
- The stated standard ordering arrangement is bakery pickup.
- Delivery may be available for select large orders by special arrangement.
- Customers can visit the contact page for order-request information.

## Frequently Asked Questions
**Does Sweet Clover offer delivery?**

The stated standard arrangement is bakery pickup. Delivery may be available for select large orders by special arrangement.

**Does Sweet Clover accept custom orders?**

Yes. Listed custom options include cakes, cookies, cupcakes, and dessert boxes.

**How far in advance should custom orders be placed?**

At least seven days in advance is recommended.

**Does Sweet Clover offer gluten-free products?**

Select gluten-free items are listed. However, the bakery handles wheat and other allergens and cannot guarantee an allergen-free environment.

**How can customers place an order?**
The listed methods are visiting the bakery, calling, or submitting the online custom-order request form.
